newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM 1 ATLETICO MADRID 1 RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM 1 ATLETICO MADRID 1 RESULT.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands and Spain's Atletico Madrid drew 1-1 (halftime 0-1) in their European cup quarter-final first leg match on Wednesday.

Ajax - 1-Edwin van de Saar, 3-Danny Blind, 4-Frank de Boer, 6-Ronald de Boer, 7-Tijani Babangida (16-Nordin Wooter 71), 8-Richard Witschge, 9-Patrick Kluivert, 10-Jari Litmanen, 11-Marc Overmars, 18-Kiki Musampa (19-Arnold Scholten 47), 29-Mario Melchiot (2-John Veldman 84).

Atletico - 1-Jose Molina, 3-Toni Munoz, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 6-Santi Denia, 9-Juan Esnaider, 10-Milinko Pantic (12-Veljko Paunovic 76), 14-Diego Simeone, 15-Carlos Aguilera, 20-Delfi Geli (8-Juan Vizcaino 88), 21-Jose Caminero, 24-Radek Bejbl.
